SRE Oncall: Quick heads-up — after the cu11->cu12 container rebuilds landed on the canary GPU pool, we're seeing intermittent multi-GPU NCCL hangs during warmup and provisioning queues spiking in us-east-1a. Anyone seeing the same?

Carl: Yep. Noticed ~20% throughput drop on matrix-multiply microbenchmarks. Logs show repeated 'NCCL WARN Allgather failed' followed by kernel thread stalls.

Anya: I pulled a node trace. Host driver is 525.60 but containers expect CUDA 12 runtime (some images reference cupti/libcuda paths for 530+). modprobe shows 525 loaded. Suspect PTX JIT fallback and CPU-side compile pauses are amplifying latency.

Luis: Also seeing a provisioning backlog. Autoscaler queues jump to 150 pending pods; kube events include ImagePullBackOff and repeated errors: 'failed to map NVML handle' on newly provisioned AMIs. Warm pool drained, ramp up failing.

deploy-bot: Started image build: cu12-optimized-runtime:build-20260315-0912 (img id: sha256:abcd1234). Triggered by infra/cuda-toolkit-upgrade pipeline.

Carl: Snippet from node logs:
```
Mar 15 09:21:42 gpu-node-12 kernel: [12345.678901] NCCL WARN Allgather failed 1
Mar 15 09:21:42 gpu-node-12 nvidia-smi: failed to get NVML device handle: unknown error
Mar 15 09:21:43 gpu-node-12 dockerd: docker: Error response from daemon: could not start container: failed to map device: no such file or directory
```

Anya: Short-term mitigation: pin canary to cu11-compatible runtime images (we have cu11-shim images), disable aggressive PTX caching in image build, and set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS to avoid unexpected P2P paths across NUMA. That should reduce the hangs while we diagnose host-driver mismatch.

SRE Oncall: Rolling back canary pool to cu11 now. Please coordinate with infra to hold further cu12 rebuilds until host-driver upgrades are staged. Also note a cost hit from repeated rebuilds and retries — rough estimate +12 GPU-hours so far.

Luis: Filed incident INC-4321 with initial blast radius and affected clusters. I've added 4 hot spare nodes to the warm pool and bumped autoscaler max surge to 30% to reduce pending queue.

Carl: Follow-up: found kernel/rtld related warnings on one AMI: 'ld.so: object \'/usr/local/cuda-12/lib64/libcudart.so\' has text relocations' — that's causing loader to reject mapped libs on hardened kernels. We should validate glibc/ld configurations in the AMI bake.

Anya: Agreed. Next steps:
- freeze toolkit image in staging (no further cu12 promotes)
- run an automated probe across zones that exercises NVML, NCCL allgather/allreduce stress and driver APIs
- add a kernel/ABI checklist to the AMI bake job (glibc, ldconfig, text reloc checks)
- update runbook with quick rollback command: `kubectl label node canary=cu11 && restart daemonset gpu-driver`

SRE Oncall: Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone finds a reproducible reduced test, post it and we'll escalate to ML infra. :thumbsup:
